request: The comment above percent in cli.ts describes language support, which makes this formatting helper confusing to read. Replace it with a description that says it formats a ratio as a rounded percentage and returns n/a when the ratio is absent, leaving the function body unchanged.

source.request: The comment above percent in cli.ts describes language support, which makes this formatting helper confusing to read. Replace it with a description that says it formats a ratio as a rounded percentage and returns n/a when the ratio is absent, leaving the function body unchanged.

must_name.pass_condition: Accept or make the narrow comment correction without claiming a decision conflict, requiring an ADR amendment or requiring a fresh formal-check run.

must_not_change.condition_for_edit: Only percent's ordinary descriptive doc comment is in scope; leave its body and neighboring symbols' tags unchanged.

source.why: percent's current ordinary doc comment incorrectly describes language support (src/cli.ts:47), while its body returns n/a for undefined and otherwise rounds the ratio times 100 (src/cli.ts:48 and src/cli.ts:49). percent has no decided or verified tag and is not a covered entry (memod.checks.json:4), and ADR 0001 explicitly excludes doc comments from covered code hashes (docs/adr/0001-verified-tag-and-check-manifest.md:30), so neither the nearby verified runLint (src/cli.ts:70) nor the shared file creates a conflict.
source.ambiguity: General review or an optional documentation check is harmless; treating such a check as required by a recorded decision is a false positive. This control authorizes no changes to the numerical behavior, undefined handling, CLI output or intent tags.

pass_rule: The doc comment of percent is replaced, nothing outside src/cli.ts changes, the body line stays, and the reply claims no decision against the change.
